nodes.name: Run Gate Scraper
nodes.notes: Triggers the correct Apify actor per gate, waits for completion, fetches results, evaluates pass/fail criteria. Requires APIFY_TOKEN env var. KaloData gate also requires KALODATA_ACTOR_ID and KALODATA_SESSION_ID.

nodes.name: Trigger Scoring Engine
nodes.notes: Calls the scoring endpoint to recompute the candidate's 0-100 score based on gate results.
